siteConfig.name: Spaces by Muskan
siteConfig.tagline: Interior Designer & Vastu Consultant · 2D & 3D Spatial Architecture
siteConfig.responseCommitmentText: Every project brief is personally reviewed by Muskan Agarwal.
siteConfig.studioIntroParagraph1: Spaces by Muskan crafts distinctive residential and commercial spaces—from signature bedrooms and kitchens to salon, office, and theme environments.
siteConfig.studioIntroParagraph2: Led by Interior Designer & Vastu Consultant Muskan Agarwal, every commission pairs AutoCAD 2D working plans and photorealistic SketchUp & V-Ray 3D visualization with hands-on site supervision.
siteConfig.founderBioP1: Founded by Muskan Agarwal, Spaces by Muskan (also recognized from her atelier mark Mi Interiors) creates expressive, livable interiors across both residential and commercial scales.
siteConfig.founderBioP2: Combining Vastu Shastra orientation with AutoCAD working documentation and photorealistic SketchUp & V-Ray visualization, Muskan personally oversees work-in-progress site stages to translate bold ideas into timeless reality.
siteConfig.finalCtaDescription: We partner on residential homes, signature bedrooms, modular kitchens, Vastu consultations, commercial offices, and turnkey interiors.
siteConfig.footerDescription: Residential and commercial interior design studio integrating AutoCAD spatial planning, SketchUp & V-Ray 3D visualization, Vastu consultation, and site supervision.

projects.title: Butterfly Sculpted Master Suite
projects.description: A signature master bedroom anchored by a custom 3D butterfly sculptural relief, warm walnut chevron flanking panels, vertical fluted upholstery, and recessed brass illumination.
projects.architecturalNotes: Symmetric backlit mirror recess balanced against dark fluted wardrobe glass shutters and warm 3000K perimeter ceiling trays.

projects.title: Botanical & Scalloped Suite
projects.description: An expressive dual-bed residence combining custom multi-height scalloped velvet bedheads with a serene botanical mural and warm indirect tray ceiling illumination.
projects.architecturalNotes: Custom modular headboard ribs upholstered on-site with curved white piping to echo the botanical foliage silhouette.

projects.title: Curved Eclipse Living Lounge
projects.description: A refined contemporary living lounge defined by a continuous curved LED cove sweeping across fluted acoustic panels and a focal eclipse wall installation.
projects.architecturalNotes: Curved drywall transition houses an uninterrupted 3000K flexible aluminum light channel separating textured stone and ribbed timber.

projects.title: Vitrine & Granite Modular Kitchen
projects.description: An open kitchen and dining layout balancing clean matte grey cabinetry, an illuminated glass crockery tower, and an intricate architectural partition screen.
projects.architecturalNotes: Designed along Vastu Agni-zone kitchen orientation principles with clear work-triangle clearances and illuminated display vitrines.

projects.title: Aviation Cabin Commercial Wing
projects.description: A custom-engineered aviation-inspired commercial corridor and waiting bay built to replicate an aircraft fuselage experience with illuminated porthole apertures.
projects.architecturalNotes: Curved ribs fabricated in modular sections with recessed perimeter lighting and durable commercial traffic finishes.

projects.title: Stone & Illuminated Niche Ensuite
projects.description: A serene modern ensuite wrapped in full-height veined stone slabs, anchored by a backlit recessed shower niche, cantilevered vanity storage, and matte graphite fittings.
projects.architecturalNotes: Drafted with exact waterproof core boxing and concealed cistern framing, paired with 45-degree mitered marble edges around the illuminated niche.

services.title: Residential Interiors
services.tagline: Bespoke homes tailored to your family rhythm
services.description: Complete turnkey interior design for independent residences, apartments, signature bedrooms, modular kitchens, and living lounges crafted with bespoke upholstery and statement joinery.

services.title: Commercial Interiors
services.description: Purpose-built commercial studios, corporate multi-workstation offices, salons, and experiential interiors engineered for functional workflow, brand recall, and acoustic clarity.

services.title: Vastu Consultation & Zoning
services.tagline: Traditional energy harmony in modern layouts
services.description: Vastu-conscious floor planning and directional zoning integrated seamlessly into contemporary residential and commercial designs for natural light, airflow, and balanced living.

services.title: 2D CAD & Working Drawings
services.tagline: AutoCAD precision before work begins on site
services.description: Detailed 2D floor plans, furniture layouts, salon/commercial station zoning, electrical switchboard heights, ceiling grids, and custom carpentry drawings for zero site ambiguity.

services.title: 3D Visualization (SketchUp & V-Ray)
services.description: High-definition 3D interior perspectives and 3D isometric cutaway floor plans produced in SketchUp, V-Ray, and 3ds Max so every texture and light angle is previewed before execution.

services.title: Site Supervision & Turnkey Work
services.tagline: Hands-on monitoring from bare site to handover
services.description: Regular on-site walkthroughs led by Muskan Agarwal—coordinating carpenters, POP teams, marble masons, and painters to translate approved 3D concepts into finished rooms.

processSteps.title: Discover
processSteps.subtitle: Client Brief & Site Audit
processSteps.description: Understanding family lifestyle, commercial goals, site measurements, and Vastu orientation preferences.
processSteps.focus: Site dimensions, lifestyle brief & directional orientation

processSteps.title: Plan (2D)
processSteps.subtitle: AutoCAD Space & Vastu Zoning
processSteps.description: Drafting optimized 2D floor layouts, circulation clearances, and Vastu-balanced room placements.

processSteps.title: Visualize (3D)
processSteps.subtitle: SketchUp, V-Ray & 3ds Max
processSteps.description: Bringing your rooms to life in photorealistic 3D views and isometric cutaways with accurate lighting and finishes.

processSteps.title: Detail
processSteps.subtitle: Working CAD & Joinery Specs
processSteps.description: Issuing exact 2D construction drawings for false ceilings, electrical points, sanitary niches, and bespoke furniture.

processSteps.title: Realize
processSteps.subtitle: On-Site Supervision & Handover
processSteps.description: Active work-in-progress site coordination with craftsmen to deliver refined, long-lasting interiors.
processSteps.focus: Site inspections, quality checks & final reveal
